Title: General availability: Additional Azure ExpressRoute peering locations

Body.Content:
We are announcing the expansion of our ExpressRoute services with the introduction of several new peering locations in Europe and Israel. 

  • Zurich2
  • Milan2
  • Tel Aviv2

As part of this announcement, we would like to inform you that we will be discontinuing the ExpressRoute peering location in Bogota. You can visit the ExpressRoute Locations and Partners webpage for additional peering locations and partnering service providers to create your connections.
